notes: Same immutable index per before/after layout; ordinary and RGB indexes were historically built with different indexing worker counts.

Benchmark provenance was collected after a recovery restart; cloud/pruning/final/hardware.txt records the actual measurement session hardware.
Infrastructure identifiers and operational logs are omitted from public evidence; raw measurements are unchanged.
